sentences.text:
Applicant :- Manju Singh Sengar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned trial court to decide the Case No. 1602 of 2019, arising out of Case Crime No. 620 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Barra, District Kanpur Nagar, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kanpur Nagar, expeditiously within a stipulated period.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant before this Court is the informant/aggrieved wife.
It is further submitted that the case is pending since the year 2019.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

6. In the facts and circumstances of the case, the learned trial court is directed to make all the endeavours for expeditious disposal of Case No. 1602 of 2019, arising out of Case Crime No. 620 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Barra, District Kanpur Nagar, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kanpur Nagar,
without granting unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.

entities.text: Police Station Barra, District Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
7. It is also made clear that the Court/Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 6.5.2025 Rmk.
